name: Backsliders
overview: The Scriptures reveal that backsliding involves turning away from God's commandments, as seen in the Israelites' testing of the LORD at Massah and Meribah, where they doubted His presence among them despite His guidance (Exodus 17:1,7). Leviticus 26 warns that refusing to obey God's statutes and breaking His covenant leads to severe consequences, including judgment and defeat by enemies (Leviticus 26:14-17). This underscores the seriousness of spiritual unfaithfulness and the resulting divine discipline that follows persistent rebellion against God.
